derivation: from the same as H3348 (יָקֶה) and H410 (אֵל); obedience of God;

occurrences.text: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.
